state.label: Base
state.note: Your contractor pricing; Riverfront $1.1M, Lake View $800K, Regular $625K

hard.label: Private road and drainage
hard.bench: Your contractor pricing: $150 per LF on a 1,700 LF spine road from the gate to the bluff, about $255K. Research range was $147 to $448 per LF.

hard.label: Clearing
hard.bench: Done by your grader along with the rough grading. Research range was $4,000 to $9,000 per acre.

hard.label: Rough grading
hard.bench: Your grader’s price: $500 per acre across the whole site.

hard.label: Erosion control and stormwater
hard.bench: Your grader installs and maintains it; this covers silt fence and materials.

hard.label: Water main and services (plumbing)
hard.bench: West Knox Utility District. Low end of the $70 to $150 per LF range with your subs, plus $1,200 per service.

hard.label: Fire hydrants
hard.bench: Four hydrants along the 1,700 LF road.

hard.label: Underground electric
hard.bench: Lenoir City Utilities Board, most likely. Low end of the $7K to $17K per lot range, with your crews trenching and setting conduit.

hard.label: Septic systems, installed per lot
hard.bench: Your price: about $20,000 per lot. Installed as each lot sells, so it is paid from sale proceeds.

hard.label: Community sewer (alternative)
hard.bench: Not used. A TPUC-regulated drip system runs $30K to $60K per lot. Set lots served above 0 to use it.

hard.label: Front entrance and gate
hard.bench: Your price for the whole front entrance through your contacts. No landscaping.

soft.label: Surveys and soil maps
soft.bench: Your budget: about $20,000 for surveys, site plans and the soil maps.
